dct_title_s: Revised Plan presented to the Harbor Line Board
dct_description_sm: Map shows the boundary line between N.Y. and N.J., C.R.R. of N.J., pile bridges connecting R.R. from mainland to areas filled in N.Y. Bay, and the hydrology of the water between Ellis Island and Bedloes Island.
NOTE: Map is NOT to SCALE
